SELECT TOP 25
    qs.last_execution_time,
    qs.execution_count,
    qs.total_worker_time,
    qs.total_elapsed_time,
    qs.total_logical_reads,
    st.text AS sql_text,
    qs.plan_handle
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
ORDER BY qs.last_execution_time ASC;

eval.rubric: Least-recently-used cached plans: ORDER BY last_execution_time ascending with query text via dm_exec_sql_text.

source.origin_completion:
WITH query_history AS (
    SELECT
        sql_handle,
        plan_handle,
        SUM(execution_count) AS execution_count,
        SUM(total_elapsed_time) AS total_elapsed_time
    FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats
    GROUP BY
        sql_handle,
        plan_handle
)
SELECT
    r.session_id,
    r.status,
    r.command,
    r.wait_type,
    r.wait_time,
    r.cpu_time,
    r.total_elapsed_time AS current_elapsed_time_ms,
    qh.total_elapsed_time / NULLIF(qh.execution_count, 0) / 1000 AS average_elapsed_time_ms,
    qh.execution_count,
    st.text
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
JOIN query_history AS qh
    ON qh.sql_handle = r.sql_handle
    AND qh.plan_handle = r.plan_handle
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) AS st
WHERE r.total_elapsed_time > qh.total_elapsed_time / NULLIF(qh.execution_count, 0) / 1000
ORDER BY
    r.total_elapsed_time DESC;
source.edit_notes: Replaced origin gold: requests.total_elapsed_time is milliseconds and query_stats.total_elapsed_time is microseconds. Convert stats to ms before comparing. Exclude the current session.

SELECT
    r.session_id,
    r.status,
    r.command,
    r.wait_type,
    r.wait_time,
    r.cpu_time,
    r.total_elapsed_time AS current_elapsed_ms,
    qs.total_elapsed_time / NULLIF(qs.execution_count, 0) / 1000.0 AS avg_elapsed_ms,
    qs.execution_count,
    st.text AS query_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
    ON qs.sql_handle = r.sql_handle
    AND qs.plan_handle = r.plan_handle
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) AS st
WHERE r.session_id <> @@SPID
  AND r.total_elapsed_time > qs.total_elapsed_time / NULLIF(qs.execution_count, 0) / 1000.0
ORDER BY
    r.total_elapsed_time DESC;

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0) AS last_month_start,
        DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0) AS this_month_start,
        DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 2, 0) AS two_months_ago_start
),
last_month AS (
    SELECT
        qs.sql_handle,
        qs.plan_handle,
        qs.execution_count,
        qs.total_elapsed_time / NULLIF(qs.execution_count, 0) AS avg_elapsed_us
    FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE qs.last_execution_time >= b.last_month_start
      AND qs.last_execution_time < b.this_month_start
),
two_months_ago AS (
    SELECT
        qs.sql_handle,
        qs.plan_handle,
        qs.execution_count,
        qs.total_elapsed_time / NULLIF(qs.execution_count, 0) AS avg_elapsed_us
    FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE qs.last_execution_time >= b.two_months_ago_start
      AND qs.last_execution_time < b.last_month_start
)
SELECT
    lm.sql_handle,
    lm.plan_handle,
    SUBSTRING(st.text, 1, 200) AS query_text,
    lm.execution_count AS last_month_exec_count,
    lm.avg_elapsed_us AS last_month_avg_elapsed_us,
    tma.execution_count AS two_months_ago_exec_count,
    tma.avg_elapsed_us AS two_months_ago_avg_elapsed_us,
    tma.avg_elapsed_us - lm.avg_elapsed_us AS improvement_us
FROM last_month AS lm
INNER JOIN two_months_ago AS tma
    ON tma.sql_handle = lm.sql_handle
    AND tma.plan_handle = lm.plan_handle
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(lm.sql_handle) AS st
WHERE lm.avg_elapsed_us < tma.avg_elapsed_us
ORDER BY
    improvement_us DESC;

```sql
SELECT
  TOP 5
  deqs.sql_handle,
  dest.text AS query_text,
  deqs.last_execution_time,
  deqs.execution_count,
  deqs.total_elapsed_time / deqs.execution_count AS avg_elapsed_time_ms,
  deqs.total_worker_time / deqs.execution_count AS avg_worker_time_ms
FROM
  sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS deqs
  CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(deqs.sql_handle) AS dest
WHERE
  deqs.last_execution_time >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETUTCDATE())
ORDER BY
  deqs.total_elapsed_time / deqs.execution_count ASC;
```

SELECT TOP (5)
    qs.sql_handle,
    st.text AS query_text,
    qs.last_execution_time,
    qs.execution_count,
    qs.total_elapsed_time / NULLIF(qs.execution_count, 0) / 1000.0 AS avg_elapsed_ms,
    qs.total_worker_time / NULLIF(qs.execution_count, 0) / 1000.0 AS avg_worker_ms
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
WHERE qs.last_execution_time >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETDATE())
ORDER BY
    avg_elapsed_ms;

SELECT
    tl.resource_type,
    tl.resource_database_id,
    DB_NAME(tl.resource_database_id) AS database_name,
    tl.resource_associated_entity_id,
    OBJECT_NAME(tl.resource_associated_entity_id, tl.resource_database_id) AS object_name,
    tl.request_mode,
    tl.request_type,
    tl.request_status,
    tl.request_session_id,
    s.login_name,
    s.host_name,
    s.program_name
FROM sys.dm_tran_locks AS tl
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s
    ON s.session_id = tl.request_session_id
WHERE tl.resource_database_id = DB_ID()
ORDER BY
    tl.request_session_id,
    tl.resource_type;

SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.full_name,
    u.email,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid
FROM dbo.Users AS u
INNER JOIN dbo.Payments AS p
    ON p.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE p.payment_status = N'completed'
GROUP BY
    u.user_id,
    u.full_name,
    u.email
ORDER BY
    total_paid DESC;

SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.full_name,
    w.device_type,
    w.steps,
    w.distance_km,
    w.heart_rate,
    w.recorded_at
FROM dbo.Wearable_Data AS w
INNER JOIN dbo.Users AS u
    ON u.user_id = w.user_id
WHERE w.recorded_at >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETDATE())
ORDER BY
    w.recorded_at DESC;

SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.full_name,
    AVG(ws.calories_burned) AS avg_calories_burned,
    COUNT(*) AS session_count
FROM dbo.Users AS u
INNER JOIN dbo.User_Workouts AS uw
    ON uw.user_id = u.user_id
INNER JOIN dbo.Workout_Sessions AS ws
    ON ws.user_workout_id = uw.user_workout_id
GROUP BY
    u.user_id,
    u.full_name
ORDER BY
    avg_calories_burned DESC;

SELECT
    r.recommendation_id,
    r.user_id,
    u.full_name,
    r.type,
    r.generated_text,
    r.created_at
FROM dbo.AI_Recommendations AS r
INNER JOIN dbo.Users AS u
    ON u.user_id = r.user_id
WHERE r.created_at = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.created_at)
    FROM dbo.AI_Recommendations AS r2
    WHERE r2.user_id = r.user_id
)
ORDER BY
    r.created_at DESC;

eval.rubric: One latest recommendation per user using created_at. ROW_NUMBER or correlated MAX are both fine. Do not invent a is_latest flag.

SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.full_name,
    SUM(w.duration_minutes) AS total_minutes
FROM dbo.Users AS u
INNER JOIN dbo.User_Workouts AS uw
    ON uw.user_id = u.user_id
INNER JOIN dbo.Workouts AS w
    ON w.workout_id = uw.workout_id
GROUP BY
    u.user_id,
    u.full_name
ORDER BY
    total_minutes DESC;

SELECT
    p.payment_id,
    u.full_name,
    p.amount,
    p.payment_method,
    p.payment_status,
    p.payment_date
FROM dbo.Payments AS p
INNER JOIN dbo.Users AS u
    ON u.user_id = p.user_id
WHERE p.payment_status IN (N'failed', N'declined')
  AND p.payment_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -14, GETDATE())
ORDER BY
    p.payment_date DESC;

SELECT
    uw.user_workout_id,
    u.full_name,
    w.workout_name,
    w.category,
    uw.start_date,
    uw.end_date,
    uw.status
FROM dbo.User_Workouts AS uw
INNER JOIN dbo.Users AS u
    ON u.user_id = uw.user_id
INNER JOIN dbo.Workouts AS w
    ON w.workout_id = uw.workout_id
WHERE uw.status = N'in_progress'
ORDER BY
    uw.start_date DESC;

    st.stor_id,
    st.stor_name,
    st.city,
    st.state,
    SUM(s.qty) AS qty_sold
FROM dbo.stores AS st
INNER JOIN dbo.sales AS s
    ON s.stor_id = st.stor_id
GROUP BY
    st.stor_id,
    st.stor_name,
    st.city,
    st.state
ORDER BY
    qty_sold DESC;

    ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

    c.Region
ORDER BY
    freight_total DESC;

SELECT
    st.state,
    SUM(s.qty) AS qty_sold,
    COUNT(*) AS sale_rows
FROM dbo.sales AS s
INNER JOIN dbo.stores AS st
    ON st.stor_id = s.stor_id
GROUP BY
    st.state
ORDER BY
    qty_sold DESC;

    r.status,
    r.command,
    r.database_id,
    r.blocking_session_id,

SELECT TOP (10)
    qs.execution_count,
    qs.total_worker_time,
    qs.total_elapsed_time,
    qs.total_logical_reads,
    qs.last_execution_time,
    qs.total_worker_time / NULLIF(qs.execution_count, 0) AS avg_worker_us,
    SUBSTRING(st.text, 1, 200) AS query_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
ORDER BY
    qs.total_worker_time DESC;

SELECT
    i.object_id,
    OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name,
    i.name AS index_name,
    i.type_desc,
    s.user_seeks,
    s.user_scans,
    s.user_lookups,
    s.user_updates
FROM sys.indexes AS i
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats AS s
    ON s.object_id = i.object_id
    AND s.index_id = i.index_id
    AND s.database_id = DB_ID()
WHERE i.is_primary_key = 0
  AND i.type_desc <> N'HEAP'
  AND ISNULL(s.user_seeks, 0) = 0
  AND ISNULL(s.user_scans, 0) = 0
  AND ISNULL(s.user_lookups, 0) = 0
ORDER BY
    s.user_updates DESC;

SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    p.name AS procedure_name,
    pr.parameter_id,
    pr.name AS parameter_name,
    t.name AS type_name,
    pr.max_length,
    pr.is_output
FROM sys.procedures AS p
INNER JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = p.schema_id
LEFT JOIN sys.parameters AS pr
    ON pr.object_id = p.object_id
LEFT JOIN sys.types AS t
    ON t.user_type_id = pr.user_type_id
ORDER BY
    s.name,
    p.name,
    pr.parameter_id;

WITH london_customers AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        CompanyName
    FROM dbo.Customers
    WHERE City = N'London'
)
SELECT
    lc.CustomerID,
    lc.CompanyName,
    o.OrderID,
    o.OrderDate,
    o.Freight,
    o.ShipCity
FROM london_customers AS lc
INNER JOIN dbo.Orders AS o
    ON o.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
ORDER BY
    lc.CompanyName,
    o.OrderDate;

SELECT
    j.name AS job_name,
    h.step_id,
    h.step_name,
    h.run_date,
    h.run_time,
    h.run_duration,
    h.message
FROM dbo.sysjobhistory AS h
INNER JOIN dbo.sysjobs AS j
    ON j.job_id = h.job_id
WHERE h.run_status = 0
  AND h.run_date >= CONVERT(int, CONVERT(char(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()), 112))
ORDER BY
    h.instance_id DESC;

eval.rubric: Failed runs are run_status = 0 in dbo.sysjobhistory. run_date is an int in yyyymmdd form, so the last-day filter needs a conversion (style 112 or equivalent), not a direct datetime comparison.

SELECT
    j.job_id,
    j.name,
    j.enabled
FROM dbo.sysjobs AS j
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.sysjobschedules AS js
    WHERE js.job_id = j.job_id
)
ORDER BY
    j.name;

gold_completion:
SELECT
    j.name AS job_name,
    COUNT(*) AS successful_runs,
    AVG(h.run_duration) AS avg_run_duration
FROM dbo.sysjobhistory AS h
INNER JOIN dbo.sysjobs AS j
    ON j.job_id = h.job_id
WHERE h.run_status = 1
GROUP BY
    j.name
ORDER BY
    avg_run_duration DESC;

eval.rubric: Aggregate run_duration for run_status = 1 grouped by job. run_duration is stored as hhmmss-packed int; a plain AVG is the accepted grounded approximation here.

SELECT
    j.name AS job_name,
    s.name AS schedule_name,
    js.next_run_date,
    js.next_run_time
FROM dbo.sysjobschedules AS js
INNER JOIN dbo.sysjobs AS j
    ON j.job_id = js.job_id
INNER JOIN dbo.sysschedules AS s
    ON s.schedule_id = js.schedule_id
WHERE s.enabled = 1
ORDER BY
    js.next_run_date,
    js.next_run_time;

eval.rubric: Three-way join jobs -> jobschedules -> schedules, filtered to enabled schedules, projecting next_run_date/time.

ORDER BY

SELECT
    database_name,
    YEAR(backup_finish_date) AS backup_year,
    MONTH(backup_finish_date) AS backup_month,
    SUM(backup_size) AS total_backup_size,
    SUM(compressed_backup_size) AS total_compressed_size
FROM dbo.backupset
WHERE backup_finish_date >= DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, 0, GETDATE()), 0)
GROUP BY
    database_name,
    YEAR(backup_finish_date),
    MONTH(backup_finish_date)
ORDER BY
    database_name,
    backup_year,
    backup_month;

    r.restore_date,
    r.destination_database_name,
    r.restore_type,
    r.user_name,
    b.database_name AS source_database,
    b.backup_finish_date
FROM dbo.restorehistory AS r
LEFT JOIN dbo.backupset AS b
    ON b.backup_set_id = r.backup_set_id
ORDER BY
    r.restore_date DESC;

SELECT
    j.name AS job_name,
    a.start_execution_date,
    a.last_executed_step_id,
    a.next_scheduled_run_date
FROM dbo.sysjobactivity AS a
INNER JOIN dbo.sysjobs AS j
    ON j.job_id = a.job_id
WHERE a.start_execution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND a.stop_execution_date IS NULL
ORDER BY
    a.start_execution_date;

eval.rubric: Running jobs have a start_execution_date and a NULL stop_execution_date in sysjobactivity.

    s.step_id,
    s.step_name,
    s.subsystem,
    s.command,
    s.last_run_date,
    s.retry_attempts
FROM dbo.sysjobsteps AS s
INNER JOIN dbo.sysjobs AS j
    ON j.job_id = s.job_id
WHERE s.last_run_outcome = 0
ORDER BY
    j.name,
    s.step_id;

SELECT TOP (5)
    p.ProductID,
    p.Name,
    SUM(sod.OrderQty) AS total_qty
FROM SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
INNER JOIN SalesLT.Product AS p
    ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID
GROUP BY
    p.ProductID,
    p.Name
ORDER BY
    total_qty DESC;

eval.rubric: Sum OrderQty per product from SalesOrderDetail joined to Product, TOP 5 by that sum.

gold_completion:
SELECT
    pc.Name AS category_name,
    p.Name AS product_name,
    SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS revenue,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY pc.Name
        ORDER BY SUM(sod.LineTotal) DESC
    ) AS revenue_rank
FROM SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
INNER JOIN SalesLT.Product AS p
    ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID
INNER JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS pc
    ON pc.ProductCategoryID = p.ProductCategoryID
GROUP BY
    pc.Name,
    p.Name
ORDER BY
    category_name,
    revenue_rank;

eval.rubric: Window rank over summed LineTotal partitioned by category. Requires joining detail -> product -> category.

SELECT TOP (10)
    q.query_id,
    qt.query_sql_text,
    rs.avg_duration,
    rs.count_executions,
    p.plan_id
FROM sys.query_store_runtime_stats AS rs
INNER JOIN sys.query_store_plan AS p
    ON p.plan_id = rs.plan_id
INNER JOIN sys.query_store_query AS q
    ON q.query_id = p.query_id
INNER JOIN sys.query_store_query_text AS qt
    ON qt.query_text_id = q.query_text_id
ORDER BY
    rs.avg_duration DESC;

FROM sys.query_store_wait_stats AS ws

    ws.wait_category_desc
ORDER BY
    total_wait_ms DESC;

gold_completion:
SELECT
    AVG(avg_cpu_percent) AS avg_cpu_percent,
    AVG(avg_data_io_percent) AS avg_data_io_percent,
    MAX(max_worker_percent) AS max_worker_percent
FROM sys.dm_db_resource_stats
WHERE end_time >= DATEADD(HOUR, -1, GETDATE());

eval.rubric: Azure SQL Database resource consumption comes from sys.dm_db_resource_stats (15-second granularity); filter end_time to the last hour.

SELECT
    q.query_id,
    qt.query_sql_text,
    SUM(rs.count_executions) AS executions_today
FROM sys.query_store_runtime_stats AS rs
INNER JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats_interval AS i
    ON i.runtime_stats_interval_id = rs.runtime_stats_interval_id
INNER JOIN sys.query_store_plan AS p
    ON p.plan_id = rs.plan_id
INNER JOIN sys.query_store_query AS q
    ON q.query_id = p.query_id
INNER JOIN sys.query_store_query_text AS qt
    ON qt.query_text_id = q.query_text_id
WHERE i.start_time >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY
    q.query_id,
    qt.query_sql_text
ORDER BY
    executions_today DESC;

eval.rubric: Today's executions require joining runtime stats to the interval table and filtering interval start_time, then summing count_executions per query.

    SUM(f.TotalAmount) AS total_sales
FROM dbo.FactSales AS f

    p.Category
ORDER BY
    total_sales DESC;

    c.CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,

    ON c.CustomerKey = f.CustomerKey
GROUP BY
    c.CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.Category,
        p.ProductName,
        SUM(f.TotalAmount) AS total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.Category
            ORDER BY SUM(f.TotalAmount) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN dbo.DimProduct AS p
        ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
    GROUP BY
        p.Category,
        p.ProductName
)
SELECT
    Category,
    ProductName,
    total_sales
FROM product_sales
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY
    Category,
    total_sales DESC;

eval.rubric: Top-N per group needs a window function partitioned by Category; TOP alone is not enough.

SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    t.name AS table_name,
    SUM(p.rows) AS row_count
FROM sys.tables AS t
INNER JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
INNER JOIN sys.partitions AS p
    ON p.object_id = t.object_id
WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0
GROUP BY
    s.name,
    t.name
ORDER BY
    row_count DESC;

SELECT
    user_id,
    full_name,
    height_cm,
    weight_kg,
    weight_kg / POWER(height_cm / 100.0, 2) AS bmi,
    CASE
        WHEN weight_kg / POWER(height_cm / 100.0, 2) < 18.5 THEN N'underweight'
        WHEN weight_kg / POWER(height_cm / 100.0, 2) < 25 THEN N'normal'
        WHEN weight_kg / POWER(height_cm / 100.0, 2) < 30 THEN N'overweight'
        ELSE N'obese'
    END AS bmi_category
FROM dbo.Users
ORDER BY
    bmi DESC;
